aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misidentifies the primary changed factor and includes invalid measurement extraction.
issues: Primary factor should be press jig use vs no press jig with 10 min dry, not Normal vs line/process names.
Sub 3/Main 1/Main 2/Sub 4 are process-line subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Normal appears only as a reference in function/tension results and is not part of the stated test plan.
Header-only measurement outcome from row 26 is invalid and should be removed.
Tension rows have no usable sample values and should not be treated as measured results.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to press jig usage during 10 min dry condition.
Use Using Press jig as one condition and Don’t using Press jig as the other condition.
Move Sub 3/Main 1/Main 2/Sub 4 into subgroup/context for SP separate results.
Keep function defect under the same factor, with Normal labeled as reference if retained.
Remove header-derived measurement stats and exclude empty tension measurements.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient until regrouped; cite content/test rows, result headers, and actual data rows only.
